tokenize_text_with_bert: create a BertTokenizer and tokenize text into wordpiece tokens using the vocab file
convert_tokens_to_ids: convert a list of tokenized wordpieces into their corresponding vocabulary IDs
convert_ids_to_tokens: convert a list of vocabulary IDs back into their original wordpiece tokens
load_pretrained_tokenizer: instantiate a BertTokenizer from a pretrained model name or path using from_pretrained
save_vocabulary: save the tokenizer vocabulary to a file or directory for later reuse
